derivation: ⟨fun h => ext <| (hf.right_cancellable).mp <| DFunLike.ext_iff.1 h, fun h => congr_arg₂ _ h rfl⟩
explanation: The function-level theorem gives cancellation of precomposition by any surjective function. Applying it to the underlying functions of the continuous order homomorphisms gives the forward direction; extensionality identifies equality of homomorphisms with equality of those functions. The current proof instead uses `hf.forall` directly.
